item.title: Ukraine war spills into NATO territory as attacks reach Libya and Baltic
item.description: The war between Russia and Ukraine has again spilled into NATO territory, with a Russian cargo ship struck by a drone in the Baltic Sea over the weekend and Russian cruise missiles landing in Poland last week, while Ukrainian drones also hit Russian naval assets off the coast of Libya, according to…

item.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after scandal, pressure from Trump and tech allies
item.description: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia as CEO and president on Monday, less than two weeks after resigning amid reports of affairs including with an alleged Chinese spy. item.title: Mets sign Tarik Skubal to record $450M contract, then add Paul Goldschmidt
item.description: The New York Mets signed left-handed pitcher Tarik Skubal to a nine-year, $450 million contract and followed it within 24 hours by agreeing to a one-year, $8 million contract with first baseman Paul Goldschmidt, according to multiple reports. item.title: FDA approves first drug for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, BridgeBio’s Welgemda
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration on Monday approved the first drug to treat limb-girdle muscular dystrophy (LGMD), a group of progressive genetic muscle conditions that had previously had no approved therapy.
